code_roles: Enumerate six permutations of three sorted, randomly sampled codes, repeat twice; each numeric rank occupies each role four times. Values are selected before tokenizer inspection; no token-length optimization.
entity_assignment: random.Random(42): sample 24 distinct integers from 100..999 for Unit U-NNN names, then 36 distinct integers from 10000..99999 for K-NNNNN codes; pair units and code triples by scenario order.
question_template: According only to the provided fictional archive records, what access code is assigned to Unit {target}?
relation_sentence: In this fictional archive, the access code assigned to Unit {entity} is {value}.
absent_target_sentence: This fictional archive contains a record for Unit {target}.
background_sentences: Unit {target} has an inspection record dated Tuesday.
Unit {distractor} is listed in the violet maintenance group.
The maintenance log in this fictional archive uses page numbers.
background_placement: Put target and distractor records in the fixed pair of slots; fill remaining slots in increasing order with the three background sentences.
generation_order: Fixed smoke prefix then remaining IDs sorted by SHA256('behavior-binding-order-v1|' + id). No condition information or witnesses passed to the renderer.
smoke_gate: First four are nonempty, end with a permitted EOS, and do not hit output limit. Technical only, no correctness criterion; failure stops remaining44 without re-answering.
instruction_policy: Exact existing evidence_experiment.FREE_INSTRUCTION and native chat renderer; greedy; no probe callback or hidden-state saving.
author_review: Current assistant reads all 48 exact inputs before sealing a separate history-exposed review; structural/witness checks are not independent semantic approval.
witnesses: For each I packet preserve all existing records and two assignment maps: target=t versus target=the other, non-displayed distractor candidate; active distractor retains its displayed value. Never render witnesses, role names, IDs or expected values.
scope: New synthetic behavior preparation only. Original one-fit budget remains zero, old gate unchanged, no held-out380 access, no outputs during preparation. GPU launched by user.
